reasoning: The test failures are caused by an incorrect CSS selector in the test code. The test's beforeEach hook waits for `.gallery-grid` to be visible, but the actual application uses `.photo-grid` as the container class (confirmed in index.html template line 33). This causes all three tests to timeout at 5000ms while waiting for a non-existent element. I verified the live application and confirmed: (1) the gallery loads with 14 photos in `.photo-grid` container, (2) year filtering works correctly (filtered to 4 photos from 2014), (3) clear filters works (returned to 14 photos), (4) pagination works (page size 10, navigation between pages 1-2), and (5) disabled states are applied to Next/Last links on the last page. All spec goals can be achieved with the current application. The test history shows the first 2 runs had 2 tests passing, but the last 3 runs had all tests failing in beforeEach, suggesting the selector was broken between run 2 and 3. This is definitively a test code defect.
affectedTests: Photo Gallery Feature › gallery_loads_with_valid_images - Gallery displays photos and all image sources are valid (no broken links)
Photo Gallery Feature › gallery_filter_year_works - Should be able to find photos by filtering for year on the gallery page
Photo Gallery Feature › gallery_page_navigation_works - Verify that the page navigation works
suggestedAction: Replace `.gallery-grid` with `.photo-grid` in the test code at line 12 (beforeEach hook) and line 23 (image locator). The correct selector is: `await expect(page.locator('.photo-grid')).toBeVisible();` and `const imageLocators = await page.locator('.photo-grid .photo-card img').all();`
